home.title: admin.education
home.description: Public method for systems administration and technology education. Knowledge stays free.
home.h1: Systems administration as a public method.
home.lead: admin.education is a teaching surface. Not a ministry. Not a course store. Not a bid profile.
home.intro: The work is infrastructure, applied AI literacy, and measurement. Knowledge stays free. Ownership of the method stays with the operator of this domain.
what_items: A spine for long-form writing and lab notes.
A place to publish method without selling a visa, a diploma, or a miracle.
A public record that the operator is a systems administrator and an educator, not a state institution.
what_not_items: Not RateZip.com. That ledger is dated work, 2007 to 2022.
Not freelancer.com/u/kerberus. That page is a hire record from 2006.
Not a concert promoter and not a borrowed album title.
Not a doctorate. There is no PhD here. The diploma thesis remains unfinished.
home.note: If a sentence cannot be measured or sourced, it does not belong on this domain.

method.title: Method
method.description: How admin.education teaches: measurement first, free knowledge, White Hat only.
method.lead: Measure first. Teach second. Do not invent a title to carry the sentence.
method.rules_heading: Rules that stay on the page
rules_items: Knowledge is free. No visit required. Online only.
White Hat only. Commands are metaphors on your own machines. Nothing is executed against a third party.
Consent first. Attribution and reciprocity. Small shared core, local project.
School record and platform exams stay on two lines. They are not the same object. Platform exams live on Exams.
Affiliate work is marked in the sentence when money is involved.
operator_items: Systems administrator since 2002. Webmin, Virtualmin, CentOS first. Later machines include Linode, Vercel, DigitalOcean.
Default is self-host when speed is not the priority.
Educator in informatics, IT, and AI. Independent. Never employed by Serbian state institutions.
Vukova diploma, OŠ Nikola Tesla, Vinča, 11 June 1998. Subjects on that school diploma: English, biology, physics, mathematics.
No doctorate. Diploma thesis unfinished. Then remote work for a Canadian company.
method.muted: Anyone can ask for additions or sources on a stated fact.

writing.title: Writing
writing.description: Long-form writing for admin.education lives on Substack.
writing.lead: The paper is on Substack. This domain is the spine.
writing.intro: Long form goes to arhitektahaosa.substack.com. Short public cuts go to Bluesky first, then the other live surfaces. This site does not reprint a feed.
writing.priority: Articles carry the method. Short posts are surface. If the two disagree, the article wins.
writing.note: X is not listed. LinkedIn is not used as a draft surface here.

exams.lead: The hire-platform UI labels these Certifications. On this domain they stay marketplace exams. Not a ministry diploma. Not a doctorate. School record stays on Method.

exams.note: Anyone can ask for a source on a stated fact. If a later official Skillshop, Adobe, or Microsoft ID is produced, it gets its own line. These tiles are not that.
